panels.title: Observed tactics (ATT&CK)
panels.description: Each event_type is mapped to its primary ATT&CK tactic. Same mapping logic as intel/mitre.py — replicated in SQL for live querying.

targets.queryText:
SELECT 'Reconnaissance (TA0043)' AS tactic, COUNT(*) AS count FROM alerts WHERE event_type IN ('dns_any_query', 'dns_zone_transfer', 'http_active_recon') AND timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  UNION ALL
SELECT 'Initial Access (TA0001)' AS tactic, COUNT(*) AS count FROM alerts WHERE event_type IN ('http_exploit_attempt', 'ldap_jndi_lookup', 'smb_exploit_attempt', 'ssh_login_success', 'telnet_login_success') AND timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  UNION ALL
SELECT 'Execution (TA0002)' AS tactic, COUNT(*) AS count FROM alerts WHERE event_type IN ('docker_api_exec', 'docker_api_image_pull', 'kubernetes_pod_exec', 'mysql_udf_rce', 'postgresql_copy_program_rce', 'redis_eval', 'redis_module_load', 'ssh_command_input', 'telnet_command_input') AND timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  UNION ALL
SELECT 'Persistence (TA0003)' AS tactic, COUNT(*) AS count FROM alerts WHERE event_type IN ('mysql_outfile_write') AND timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  UNION ALL
SELECT 'Privilege Escalation (TA0004)' AS tactic, COUNT(*) AS count FROM alerts WHERE event_type IN ('docker_api_container_escape', 'kubernetes_pod_escape') AND timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  UNION ALL
SELECT 'Credential Access (TA0006)' AS tactic, COUNT(*) AS count FROM alerts WHERE event_type IN ('ftp_anonymous_login', 'ftp_login_attempt', 'http_credential_submit', 'imap_auth_attempt', 'imap_login_attempt', 'kubernetes_secret_access', 'ldap_bind_attempt', 'mssql_login_attempt', 'mysql_login_attempt', 'pop3_auth_attempt', 'pop3_login_attempt', 'postgresql_login_attempt', 'redis_auth_attempt', 'rsync_auth_attempt', 'sip_register_attempt', 'smb_session_setup', 'smtp_auth_attempt', 'snmp_community_attempt', 'snmp_default_community', 'ssh_login_failed', 'ssh_login_success', 'telnet_login_failed', 'telnet_login_success', 'vnc_auth_attempt') AND timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  UNION ALL
SELECT 'Discovery (TA0007)' AS tactic, COUNT(*) AS count FROM alerts WHERE event_type IN ('dns_version_probe', 'docker_api_enumerate', 'kubernetes_enumerate', 'kubernetes_rbac_enumerate', 'ldap_anonymous_bind', 'ldap_search', 'nfs_export_enumeration', 'nfs_portmap_dump', 'nfs_request', 'rsync_module_enumeration', 'sip_extension_probe', 'sip_scan', 'smb_negotiate') AND timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  UNION ALL
SELECT 'Lateral Movement (TA0008)' AS tactic, COUNT(*) AS count FROM alerts WHERE event_type IN ('rdp_connection', 'rdp_handshake', 'smb_exploit_attempt') AND timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  UNION ALL
SELECT 'Collection (TA0009)' AS tactic, COUNT(*) AS count FROM alerts WHERE event_type IN ('elasticsearch_data_access', 'elasticsearch_query_probe', 'imap_mailbox_access', 'mysql_file_read', 'nfs_mount_attempt', 'nfs_portmap_dump', 'pop3_mailbox_access', 'postgresql_file_access', 'rsync_anonymous_access', 'rsync_file_request', 'snmp_community_attempt', 'snmp_default_community') AND timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  UNION ALL
SELECT 'Command and Control (TA0011)' AS tactic, COUNT(*) AS count FROM alerts WHERE event_type IN ('dns_tunneling_suspected', 'ftp_file_upload', 'ldap_jndi_lookup', 'smtp_open_relay', 'ssh_file_download', 'ssh_file_upload', 'telnet_file_download') AND timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  UNION ALL
SELECT 'Impact (TA0040)' AS tactic, COUNT(*) AS count FROM alerts WHERE event_type IN ('memcached_amplification_attempt', 'memcached_flush_all', 'memcached_stats_probe', 'mongodb_destructive', 'mongodb_ransom_note', 'sip_toll_fraud_attempt', 'snmp_bulk_request', 'snmp_set_request') AND timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  ORDER BY count DESC

panels.title: Top event types (raw)
panels.description: Unmapped event types — useful for finding new attack patterns to extend the MITRE mapping with.

targets.queryText: SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS hits, COUNT(DISTINCT source_ip) AS unique_ips, SUM(CASE WHEN severity='critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical FROM alerts WHERE timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY hits DESC LIMIT 20
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS hits, COUNT(DISTINCT source_ip) AS unique_ips, SUM(CASE WHEN severity='critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical FROM alerts WHERE timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY hits DESC LIMIT 20

targets.queryText:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', datetime(CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp) / (MAX((($__to) - ($__from)) / 240000, 60)) AS INTEGER) * (MAX((($__to) - ($__from)) / 240000, 60)), 'unixepoch')) AS time,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('dns_any_query', 'dns_zone_transfer', 'http_active_recon') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Reconnaissance",
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('http_exploit_attempt', 'ldap_jndi_lookup', 'smb_exploit_attempt', 'ssh_login_success', 'telnet_login_success') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Initial Access",
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('docker_api_exec', 'docker_api_image_pull', 'kubernetes_pod_exec', 'mysql_udf_rce', 'postgresql_copy_program_rce', 'redis_eval', 'redis_module_load', 'ssh_command_input', 'telnet_command_input') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Execution",
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('mysql_outfile_write') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Persistence",
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('docker_api_container_escape', 'kubernetes_pod_escape') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Privilege Escalation",
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('ftp_anonymous_login', 'ftp_login_attempt', 'http_credential_submit', 'imap_auth_attempt', 'imap_login_attempt', 'kubernetes_secret_access', 'ldap_bind_attempt', 'mssql_login_attempt', 'mysql_login_attempt', 'pop3_auth_attempt', 'pop3_login_attempt', 'postgresql_login_attempt', 'redis_auth_attempt', 'rsync_auth_attempt', 'sip_register_attempt', 'smb_session_setup', 'smtp_auth_attempt', 'snmp_community_attempt', 'snmp_default_community', 'ssh_login_failed', 'ssh_login_success', 'telnet_login_failed', 'telnet_login_success', 'vnc_auth_attempt') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Credential Access",
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('dns_version_probe', 'docker_api_enumerate', 'kubernetes_enumerate', 'kubernetes_rbac_enumerate', 'ldap_anonymous_bind', 'ldap_search', 'nfs_export_enumeration', 'nfs_portmap_dump', 'nfs_request', 'rsync_module_enumeration', 'sip_extension_probe', 'sip_scan', 'smb_negotiate') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Discovery",
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('rdp_connection', 'rdp_handshake', 'smb_exploit_attempt') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Lateral Movement",
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('elasticsearch_data_access', 'elasticsearch_query_probe', 'imap_mailbox_access', 'mysql_file_read', 'nfs_mount_attempt', 'nfs_portmap_dump', 'pop3_mailbox_access', 'postgresql_file_access', 'rsync_anonymous_access', 'rsync_file_request', 'snmp_community_attempt', 'snmp_default_community') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Collection",
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('dns_tunneling_suspected', 'ftp_file_upload', 'ldap_jndi_lookup', 'smtp_open_relay', 'ssh_file_download', 'ssh_file_upload', 'telnet_file_download') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Command and Control",
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('memcached_amplification_attempt', 'memcached_flush_all', 'memcached_stats_probe', 'mongodb_destructive', 'mongodb_ransom_note', 'sip_toll_fraud_attempt', 'snmp_bulk_request', 'snmp_set_request') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Impact"
FROM alerts WHERE timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
GROUP BY CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp) / (MAX((($__to) - ($__from)) / 240000, 60)) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY time
